fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami and Florida politics and the state-controlled gambling system, including discussion of dog tracks and horse tracks and their economic impact. Features local columns such as "Notebook" (J. M. Phillips), "They Tell Me," and "Things I'd Like to Know," along with items on loan sharks and illegal contracts, allegations of "blackmail" involving newspaper publicity, and notes on the Irish Sweepstakes. Also includes sports/racing coverage and tips ("Jockey Jimmy" reports) and extensive local advertising for Miami-area businesses and nightlife venues.
